fields.description: Unique ID, e.g. CKM-002. Used in shareable links (?stone=CKM-002), so avoid changing it after launch.

fields.name: materials

fields.description: Add each material with the + button, e.g. Gray granite

fields.label: Image description (alt text)

fields.description: Tabs are shown from lowest to highest.
